verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's own agentic chat lets natural-language requests drive real actions: autonomous web exploration in Native Function Calling (Agentic Mode), Open Terminal installing dependencies and starting servers, sub-agents, and hands-free voice. However, nothing shows the product's own features (settings, memory, automations, admin) being operated by natural-language command; the memory docs say these are managed manually through Settings menus. missing for 10: natural-language control of the product's own configuration and features (e.g. creating automations or managing memory by command), independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: By enabling Native Function Calling (Agentic Mode), you allow quality models to independently explore the web, verify facts, and follow links autonomously.
Your AI can install dependencies, write the app, start its server, and inspect the output.
Sub-agents let a model hand a focused piece of work to a second agent that runs in parallel, then use the result to continue.
Speech-to-text, text-to-speech, hands-free voice & video calls
